heading: Working Frame
text: City + State, both by design. Aligned, not identical.

heading: Shared Goal
text: Build one stronger movement, not competing city/state or SBU / Fair Rent NYC / NYC Artist Coalition lanes.

heading: Use Rules
text: Use this as shared memory, not a perfect transcript. Keep updates brief, factual, action-oriented, and careful with sensitive tenant and business information.

heading: Current Shared Language
text: CRS gives small businesses and cultural spaces a fair chance to renew leases with predictable increases so neighborhoods do not lose local anchors to rent shocks.

heading: City Lane
text: The city lane remains important. Confirm current Council status before broad release.

heading: State Lane
text: The Albany bill is the live introduced vehicle as of the source date.

heading: Current Bill-Posture Note
text: Keep core CRS focused, universal, and winnable. Treat SBJSA-derived renewal / tenure language, vacancy penalties, emergency provisions, square-footage caps, and Albany-only edits as questions for separate legal / policy review before settled campaign position.

heading: Data / Signup Principle
text: Every signup should lead to clear follow-up. Parallel lists are acceptable only if source, consent, owner, and follow-up are clear.
